model.name: requirement.classifyType
model.description: Resolve Requirement subtypes (Bug, ChangeRequest) via ior:class. ClassRegistry has own loaders per subtype (same defaults as Requirement). TRACE_ICONS + app.css have per-type entries. rb-object-item resolves icon from type string (bug/changerequest). FORWARD_KEYS treat Bug/ChangeRequest identically to Requirement (useCases[], tasks[]).
